basic_details.total_vacancies: General Duty Medical Officer (E1 Grade); Sr. Medical Officer (Specialist) (E2 Grade)
basic_details.short_information: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL), a Govt. of India Undertaking, has invited Indian nationals to apply for 33 posts (tentative) of General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO, E1 Grade, Rs 60000-3%-180000) and Sr. Medical Officer (Specialist, E2 Grade, Rs 70000-3%-200000) in its hospitals and dispensaries at Trichy, Bhopal, Haridwar, Hyderabad, Jhansi, Ranipet, Chennai and Nagpur. Applications under Advertisement No. 04/2026 are online only at careers.bhel.in, from 1 December 2026, 10:00 AM to 31 December 2026, 11:45 PM. Selection is by personal interview.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid online through SBI Collect. The applicant may have to bear bank charges over and above the fee. In SBI Collect, type "Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited Bhopal" in the search bar and choose Payment Category "Deposit of Security Deposit (SD)".

Click SUBMIT. An APPLICATION NUMBER is generated.
Upload the scanned photograph, signature and other applicable documents. Retry until a GREEN TICK appears against each document.
Check the uploaded files with the "View File" button, then click "Submit Documents". This leads to the payment options.
Pay the applicable fee through SBI Collect, note the SBI Collect Reference Number (UTR Number), enter it in the application and upload the PDF of the e-Receipt.

The application is complete only on successful remittance of the fee. A printout of the online form and documents need not be sent to the BHEL office. If an applicant submits more than once, only the last eligible application is the final submission.

All uploaded documents must be produced in original at the interview. If original qualification documents are not available, self-attested photocopies may be produced. Original Category, PwD, Domicile (J&K), Discharge (Ex-Servicemen) and Experience documents are mandatory. Candidates who fail to produce the requisite documents will not be permitted to appear for the interview and will not get travel fare reimbursement. EWS candidates must submit an Income and Asset Certificate valid for financial year 2026-2027, at the time of Document Verification and Interviews; without it they will not be allowed to appear for the interview. OBC (NCL) candidates who fail to produce the latest caste certificate in the prescribed format will not be considered. The details entered online are final; changes to mailing address, email ID, category or post will not be entertained. Uploading blurred, edited or incorrect documents leads to disqualification. False information can lead to rejection, and after appointment to termination and prosecution. BHEL reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge or reopen the recruitment process without notice. No separate communication is sent by post; updates and interview letters appear on careers.bhel.in or https://bpl.bhel.com/bplweb_new/careers/index1.html, and BHEL will send important intimation by email. Shortlisted candidates must declare in the biodata form any arrest, prosecution, detention, fine, conviction or debarment by a Public Service Commission.

content_sections.heading: About BHEL
content_sections.text: The notice describes BHEL as a Public Sector Undertaking incorporated in 1964, backed by 15 manufacturing units, 08 service centres, 15 Regional Marketing Centres, 04 Regional Offices and 02 Repair Units. It serves sectors such as power, transportation, defence, aerospace, oil and gas, and process industries. This recruitment is for its hospitals and dispensaries at the units and offices named above.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: As of 28 November 2026 the application window has not yet opened. The notice says interview dates and letters will be published on the BHEL recruitment website.

rows.event: Opening of on-line submission of application
Closing of on-line submission of application

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 33 vacancies in total (19 Sr. Medical Officer (Specialist) E2 and 14 General Duty Medical Officer E1). The notice calls the number tentative: the actual requirement may vary, and the category-wise reservation may vary with it. The notice also gives a unit-wise break-up of specialisations and GDMO posts across the eight locations; candidates should see the official notification for it. UR is Unreserved, EWS is Economically Weaker Section, OBC is Other Backward Class (Non-creamy Layer), SC is Scheduled Caste, ST is Scheduled Tribe, PwD is Persons with Disabilities and OH is Orthopaedic Handicapped. EWS vacancies follow Government directives. OBC vacancies are only for Non-Creamy Layer candidates.

rows.post: General Duty Medical Officer E1 Grade

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Qualification and experience are counted as on 01.01.2027. Only Indian nationals may apply. The MBBS / PG degree should be recognized by Medical Council of India, and candidates should be registered with either Medical Council of India or a State Medical Council. Internship training is not considered as work experience or practice. For candidates in private medical practice, experience is considered on copies of the first and last prescription issued over the claimed period, with a self-certification confirming the period of practice. Candidates whose MBBS degree is from a foreign university or institute must upload a degree equivalence certificate or passing certificate from NBE to establish recognition in India. PwD age concession applies whether or not the post is reserved for persons with disabilities, provided the post is identified suitable for the relevant disability. The posts are identified suitable for locomotor disability (OA only), leprosy cured, dwarfism and acid attack victims. For specific eligibility of each post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will normally be placed at the minimum of the pay scale and will be on probation for one year. Besides basic pay: a cafeteria of perks limited to 31% of basic pay, Industrial Dearness Allowance (currently 59.1% of basic pay) and Non-Practicing Allowance (20% of the basic pay). These are not considered pay for calculating other benefits. Leave, medical facilities for self and dependent family members, leave encashment, Provident Fund, gratuity, BHEL pension, group insurance, performance related payment, uniform, canteen facilities, and company accommodation or HRA are admissible as per Company Rules as applicable from time to time. Candidates should possess sound health. Before joining, they must undergo a medical examination by the Company's Authorized Medical Officer, and the appointment is subject to the Company's health standards, with no relaxation.

rows.post: General Duty Medical Officer – E1 Grade

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All candidates fulfilling the eligibility conditions would be called for a Personal Interview. Candidates invited will be reimbursed to-and-fro Two-Tier AC train fare from the mailing address or the starting station, whichever is nearer to the place of interview, by the shortest route, on production of proof of journey. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice. The notice says the candidature is provisional at all stages, and BHEL verifies eligibility against original documents again at the interview. Mere shortlisting does not entail the right to an interview, and BHEL reserves the right to invite suitable candidates depending on their credentials and declarations.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid online through SBI Collect. The applicant may have to bear bank charges over and above the fee. In SBI Collect, type "Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited Bhopal" in the search bar and choose Payment Category "Deposit of Security Deposit (SD)".

Check the uploaded files with the "View File" button, then click "Submit Documents". This leads to the payment options. If an applicant submits more than once, only the last eligible application is the final submission.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Photograph (should not exceed 500 KB, .jpg) and signature (should not exceed 250 KB, .jpg, signed in blue/black ink). SSLC / HSC Mark sheet as proof of date of birth. Latest caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), as applicable; OBC(NCL) / EWS certificates must be issued on or after 01.01.2026. OBC candidates also submit a self-undertaking on non-creamy layer status. Medical Certificate issued by the Medical Board (PwD only); discharge certificates (Ex-servicemen only); domicile certificate (J&K candidates only). Copy of e-Receipt of SBI Collect payment (if applicable). MBBS degree certificate and consolidated mark sheet; PG degree certificate / consolidated mark sheet (for Sr. Medical Officer). Medical Council Registration Certificate for GDMO, and Additional Registration for Sr. Medical Officer. Experience certificates; without proper service certificates, joining letter and relieving order, and for serving employees the latest salary certificate/slip in place of relieving order. Items 3 to 9 (PDF/.jpg) must not exceed 1 MB each; the MBBS, PG, registration and experience PDFs must not exceed 2 MB each.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BHEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 33 tentative vacancies: 19 Sr. Medical Officer (Specialist) E2 posts and 14 General Duty Medical Officer E1 posts. The notice says the number may vary on further assessment.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BHEL Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: The last date is 31 December 2026, 11:45 PM. Online applications open on 1 December 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for BHEL GDMO and Specialist posts?
faq.answer: GDMO needs an MBBS degree with one year of relevant post-qualification experience or practice. Sr. Medical Officer (Specialist) needs MBBS with a Post Graduate Degree in the specialty concerned and one year of such experience. Registration with Medical Council of India or a State Medical Council is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BHEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years for GDMO and 37 years for Sr. Medical Officer (Specialist), as on 01.01.2027. Relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (Non-creamy Layer), with more for PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of BHEL Medical Officers?
faq.answer: GDMO is in E1 Grade, Rs 60000-3%-180000, and Sr. Medical Officer is in E2 Grade, Rs 70000-3%-200000. Selected candidates are normally placed at the minimum of the scale, plus perks, Industrial Dearness Allowance and Non-Practicing Allowance.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The non-refundable processing fee is Rs.400/- + 18% GST, i.e. Rs.472/-. SC/ST, PwD and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for BHEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online only at careers.bhel.in, upload the documents and pay the fee through SBI Collect. No printout needs to be sent to BHEL.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: All candidates fulfilling the eligibility conditions would be called for a Personal Interview. Two-Tier AC train fare is reimbursed on proof of journey.

faq.question: Q9. Are these permanent posts?
faq.answer: The notice says selected candidates will be on probation for one year. It does not say whether the posts are permanent or on contract.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates working in government or PSUs apply?
faq.answer: Yes, those employed in Govt. Departments, PSUs and Autonomous Bodies must apply through proper channel and produce a No Objection Certificate at the interview.
